segments.t: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands,
segments.note: 「In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands」Ὁμοίως γυναῖκες ὑποτασσόμεναι τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν

segments.t: so that, even if any don’t obey the Word,
segments.note: 「so that, even if any don’t obey the Word」ἵνα καὶ εἴ τινες ἀπειθοῦσιν τῷ λόγῳ

segments.t: they may be won by the behavior of their wives
segments.note: 「they may be won by the behavior of their wives」κερδηθήσονται διὰ τῆς τῶν γυναικῶν ἀναστροφῆς。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: without a word,
segments.note: 「without a word」ἄνευ λόγου

segments.t: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
segments.note: 「seeing your pure behavior in fear」ἐποπτεύσαντες τὴν ἐν φόβῳ ἁγνὴν ἀναστροφὴν ὑμῶν

segments.t: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning
segments.note: 「Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning」ὧν ἔστω οὐχ ὁ ἔξωθεν κόσμος。「beauty come」は英語のほぐし

segments.t: of braiding your hair,
segments.note: 「of braiding your hair」ἐμπλοκῆς τριχῶν。「your」は英語の補い

segments.t: and of wearing gold ornaments
segments.note: 「and of wearing gold ornaments」καὶ περιθέσεως χρυσίων

segments.t: or of putting on fine clothing,
segments.note: 「or of putting on fine clothing」ἢ ἐνδύσεως ἱματίων。「fine」は英語の補い

segments.t: but from the hidden person of the heart,
segments.note: 「but from the hidden person of the heart」ἀλλ’ ὁ κρυπτὸς τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος

segments.t: in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit,
segments.note: 「in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit」ἐν τῷ ἀφθάρτῳ τοῦ πραέως καὶ ἡσυχίου πνεύματος

segments.t: which is very precious in God’s sight.
segments.note: 「which is very precious in God’s sight」ὅ ἐστιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ πολυτελές

segments.t: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God
segments.note: 「For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God」οὕτως γάρ ποτε αἱ ἅγιαι γυναῖκες αἱ ἐλπίζουσαι εἰς θεὸν

segments.t: also adorned themselves,
segments.note: 「also adorned themselves」καὶ ἐκόσμουν ἑαυτάς

segments.t: being in subjection to their own husbands.
segments.note: 「being in subjection to their own husbands」ὑποτασσόμεναι τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν。「their」は英語の補い

segments.t: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord,
segments.note: 「So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord」ὡς Σάρρα ὑπήκουσεν τῷ Ἀβραάμ κύριον αὐτὸν καλοῦσα

segments.t: whose children you now are
segments.note: 「whose children you now are」ἧς ἐγενήθητε τέκνα。「now」は英語の補い

segments.t: if you do well
segments.note: 「if you do well」ἀγαθοποιοῦσαι

segments.t: and are not put in fear by any terror.
segments.note: 「and are not put in fear by any terror」καὶ μὴ φοβούμεναι μηδεμίαν πτόησιν

segments.t: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge,
segments.note: 「You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge」Οἱ ἄνδρες ὁμοίως συνοικοῦντες κατὰ γνῶσιν。「your wives」は英語の補い

segments.t: giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel,
segments.note: 「giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel」ἀπονέμοντες τιμήν ὡς ἀσθενεστέρῳ σκεύει τῷ γυναικείῳ。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: as also being joint heirs of the grace of life,
segments.note: 「as also being joint heirs of the grace of life」ὡς καὶ συγκληρονόμοις χάριτος ζωῆς

segments.t: that your prayers may not be hindered.
segments.note: 「that your prayers may not be hindered」εἰς τὸ μὴ ἐγκόπτεσθαι τὰς προσευχὰς ὑμῶν

segments.t: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
segments.note: 「Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous」Τὸ δὲ τέλος πάντες ὁμόφρονες συμπαθεῖς φιλάδελφοι εὔσπλαγχνοι ταπεινόφρονες。WEB の「courteous」はビザンティン本文 φιλόφρονες に対応する。ギリシャ語本文は ταπεινόφρονες（へりくだった心）

segments.t: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult;
segments.note: 「not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult」μὴ ἀποδιδόντες κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ ἢ λοιδορίαν ἀντὶ λοιδορίας

segments.t: but instead blessing,
segments.note: 「but instead blessing」τοὐναντίον δὲ εὐλογοῦντες

segments.t: knowing that you were called to this,
segments.note: 「knowing that you were called to this」ὅτι εἰς τοῦτο ἐκλήθητε。「knowing」は英語の補い

segments.t: that you may inherit a blessing.
segments.note: 「that you may inherit a blessing」ἵνα εὐλογίαν κληρονομήσητε

segments.t: For, “He who would love life and see good days,
segments.note: 「For, “He who would love life and see good days」ὁ γὰρ θέλων ζωὴν ἀγαπᾶν καὶ ἰδεῖν ἡμέρας ἀγαθὰς

segments.t: let him keep his tongue from evil
segments.note: 「let him keep his tongue from evil」παυσάτω τὴν γλῶσσαν ἀπὸ κακοῦ

segments.t: and his lips from speaking deceit.
segments.note: 「and his lips from speaking deceit」καὶ χείλη τοῦ μὴ λαλῆσαι δόλον

segments.t: Let him turn away from evil and do good.
segments.note: 「Let him turn away from evil and do good」ἐκκλινάτω δὲ ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ ποιησάτω ἀγαθόν。「Let him」は英語の補い

segments.t: Let him seek peace and pursue it.
segments.note: 「Let him seek peace and pursue it」ζητησάτω εἰρήνην καὶ διωξάτω αὐτήν

segments.t: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous,
segments.note: 「For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous」ὅτι ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου ἐπὶ δικαίους

segments.t: and his ears open to their prayer;
segments.note: 「and his ears open to their prayer」καὶ ὦτα αὐτοῦ εἰς δέησιν αὐτῶν。「open」は英語の補い

segments.t: but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
segments.note: 「but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil」πρόσωπον δὲ κυρίου ἐπὶ ποιοῦντας κακά

segments.t: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
segments.note: 「Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?」Καὶ τίς ὁ κακώσων ὑμᾶς ἐὰν τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ ζηλωταὶ γένησθε。WEB の「imitators」はビザンティン本文 μιμηταί に対応する。ギリシャ語本文は ζηλωταί（熱心な者）

segments.t: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed.
segments.note: 「But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed」ἀλλ’ εἰ καὶ πάσχοιτε διὰ δικαιοσύνην μακάριοι

segments.t: “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
segments.note: 「“Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled”」τὸν δὲ φόβον αὐτῶν μὴ φοβηθῆτε μηδὲ ταραχθῆτε。WEB は「what they fear」とほぐす

segments.t: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts.
segments.note: 「But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts」κύριον δὲ τὸν Χριστὸν ἁγιάσατε ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν。WEB の「God」はビザンティン本文 θεόν に対応する。ギリシャ語本文は τὸν Χριστόν

segments.t: Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you,
segments.note: 「Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you」ἕτοιμοι ἀεὶ πρὸς ἀπολογίαν παντὶ τῷ αἰτοῦντι ὑμᾶς λόγον περὶ τῆς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐλπίδος

segments.t: with humility and fear,
segments.note: WEB の節立て。ギリシャ語本文では「with humility and fear」は16節の冒頭（μετὰ πραΰτητος καὶ φόβου）

segments.t: having a good conscience.
segments.note: 「having a good conscience」συνείδησιν ἔχοντες ἀγαθήν。μετὰ πραΰτητος καὶ φόβου（2–5番）は WEB では15節末に置かれるため未対応

segments.t: Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers,
segments.note: 「Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers」ἀλλὰ ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καταλαλεῖσθε。「as evildoers」は英語の補い

segments.t: they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
segments.note: 「they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ」καταισχυνθῶσιν οἱ ἐπηρεάζοντες ὑμῶν τὴν ἀγαθὴν ἐν Χριστῷ ἀναστροφήν

segments.t: For it is better, if it is God’s will,
segments.note: 「For it is better, if it is God’s will」κρεῖττον γὰρ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ εἰ θέλοι。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: that you suffer for doing what is right
segments.note: 「that you suffer for doing what is right」ἀγαθοποιοῦντας πάσχειν

segments.t: than for doing evil.
segments.note: 「than for doing evil」ἢ κακοποιοῦντας

segments.t: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous,
segments.note: 「Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous」ὅτι καὶ Χριστὸς ἅπαξ περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἔπαθεν δίκαιος ὑπὲρ ἀδίκων

segments.t: that he might bring you to God,
segments.note: 「that he might bring you to God」ἵνα ὑμᾶς προσαγάγῃ τῷ θεῷ

segments.t: being put to death in the flesh,
segments.note: 「being put to death in the flesh」θανατωθεὶς μὲν σαρκί

segments.t: but made alive in the Spirit,
segments.note: 「but made alive in the Spirit」ζῳοποιηθεὶς δὲ πνεύματι

segments.t: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
segments.note: 「in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison」ἐν ᾧ καὶ τοῖς ἐν φυλακῇ πνεύμασιν πορευθεὶς ἐκήρυξεν

segments.t: who before were disobedient
segments.note: 「who before were disobedient」ἀπειθήσασίν ποτε

segments.t: when God waited patiently in the days of Noah
segments.note: 「when God waited patiently in the days of Noah」ὅτε ἀπεξεδέχετο ἡ τοῦ θεοῦ μακροθυμία ἐν ἡμέραις Νῶε。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: while the ship was being built.
segments.note: 「while the ship was being built」κατασκευαζομένης κιβωτοῦ。κιβωτοῦ は WEB で「ship」と訳される

segments.t: In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
segments.note: 「In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water」εἰς ἣν ὀλίγοι τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ὀκτὼ ψυχαὶ διεσώθησαν δι’ ὕδατος

segments.t: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves
segments.note: 「This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you」ὃ καὶ ὑμᾶς ἀντίτυπον νῦν σῴζει βάπτισμα。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh,
segments.note: 「not the putting away of the filth of the flesh」οὐ σαρκὸς ἀπόθεσις ῥύπου

segments.t: but the answer of a good conscience toward
segments.note: 「but the answer of a good conscience toward God」ἀλλὰ συνειδήσεως ἀγαθῆς ἐπερώτημα εἰς θεόν

segments.t: God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
segments.note: 「through the resurrection of Jesus Christ」δι’ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ

segments.t: who is at the right hand of God,
segments.note: 「who is at the right hand of God」ὅς ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ θεοῦ

segments.t: having gone into heaven,
segments.note: 「having gone into heaven」πορευθεὶς εἰς οὐρανόν

segments.t: angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
segments.note: 「angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him」ἀγγέλων καὶ ἐξουσιῶν καὶ δυνάμεων ὑποταγέντων αὐτῷ。WEB の語順はほぐし
